title: Italian Clams Bake
description: A classic Italian dish featuring fresh clams, garlic, and herbs, all baked to perfection. This recipe serves 4 and is perfect for a cozy dinner.
instructions: Rinse the clams and remove any broken shells or debris.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the clams and cook for 2-3 minutes until they start to open.
Transfer the clams to a baking dish.
Add the white wine, parsley, basil, salt, and pepper to the baking dish.
Top the clams with the grated Parmesan cheese.
Cover the baking dish with aluminum foil and bake for 10-12 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 2-3 minutes until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
